title: Automation passes
description: automation-passes.json (data folder root): how the board reaches services by itself, shared by every board. File type { version: 1, passes: Pass[] } in src/integrations/passes.ts (interface File; Pass in the same file, Client in src/integrations/oauth.ts, Tokens in src/integrations/types.ts). Written by Passes.write (pretty JSON, 2-space indent, final newline, random automation-passes.json.tmp-<id> then rename, mode 0600 plus chmod). Holds secrets: secret, tokens.access, tokens.refresh, oauth.clientSecret. Passes.read rebuilds the top level as { version: 1, passes }, so other top-level keys are lost on the next write today. Unknown fields inside passes must be kept.

Pass.description: One pass. TypeScript has one interface with kind-dependent optional fields; the oneOf below states what each kind's writer (Passes.add, saveBoardKeys) always sets.

name.description: Display name; scripts can call the pass by it.

claudeName.description: The Connections (Claude) server it was made from; null: a row of its own.

url.description: The MCP server's address (mcp; key passes that are a bearer token for a server).

envName.description: Environment variable name scripts get the key as (key passes without url).

secret.description: The pasted key, one line. Secret.

board.description: Board slug: a key for that board's runs only. Missing: any board's automations.

savedAt.description: When the key was last saved (replaced keys keep createdAt).

oneOf.description: mcp: an online MCP server the board signs in to (oauth and tokens appear after sign-in).
key: a pasted key; with url the bearer token for that server, without it an environment variable named envName.
local: a program on this computer, started from Claude's own settings for claudeName at each use.

Client.description: Client (src/integrations/oauth.ts): the board's registration at the service's sign-in.

resource.description: The MCP address the token is for.

scope.description: The server's read-only scopes, space separated, when it lists any.
